Positive determinant 8u(1-q)², increasing smaller even eigenvalue and decreasing odd eigenvalue give a unique crossing and exact quadratic root. Parameter u=cos²(theta/2), c=cos(theta)=2u-1. The published finite-cycle full raw-Gram theorem is algebraically identical after multiplying its normalized Gram by N. Symbolic expansion independently verified that published quadratic in c transforms to 2 times candidate P_q(u). Thus mathematical correctness survives but not priority.
